OPTIONAL ORIGINAL TEMP MUSIC/SFX

Newly composed/synthesized for this project. No sampled/downloaded music, actor voices, or Bluey/Peppa themes. Default OFF; parent/user preview required before enabling.

Files: 40-second gentle instrumental football bed and 3 short effects (rounded ball tap, soft pass whoosh, gentle success chime), each as stereo 48 kHz WAV and 192 kb/s MP3.

The music is a simple newly composed pentatonic mallet motif over soft bass/pads with very quiet brush pulses at 96 BPM. It is a synthesized TEMP track, not a professionally produced final soundtrack.

Technical validation only; no listening review completed. Music target -25 LUFS. Effects target -30 to -32 LUFS. Audition at low volume. Use WAV and a 30–80 ms crossfade for looping. Keep off beneath narration until mix reviewed.

See manifest.json for precise file lengths/peaks and compose_original.py for complete reproducible provenance.
